abstract: AIM: The aim of our study was to evaluate pretreatment semen quality in patients with unilateral testicular cancer in comparison to semen parameters of patients suffering from other malignancies. METHODS: Semen analysis according to WHO recommendations were performed in 16 patients suffering from unilateral testicular cancer (group 1) and in 21 patients who were diagnosed to have other malignant tumors (group 2: non-Hodgkin's lymphoma: n=7, Hodgkin's disease: n=6, leukemia: n=3, osteosarcoma: n=2, rectal cancer: n=2, thyroid carcinoma: n=1) prior to anti-cancer treatment. RESULTS: Normozoospermia was observed in none of the testicular cancer patients but in five of the other patients ( p=0.047). Sperm concentration was significantly decreased in the patients of group 1 compared to those of group 2 (18.7+/-22.3x10(6)/ml versus 35.6+/-31.3x10(6)/ml, p=0.03). The percentage of rapid progressive motile spermatozoa was significantly less in testicular cancer patients than in patients suffering from other malignancies (WHO group a: 1.1+/-2.0% versus 4.7+/-5.6%, p=0.02). Normal morphological findings of spermatozoa were found in a smaller percentage in group 1 (16.2+/-6.0% versus 26.1+/-18.0%, p=0.03). CONCLUSIONS: Our investigations revealed that especially testicular cancer has an adverse influence on sperm quality. Hence, we advise careful and sufficient cryopreservation of semen in those patients taking the negative impact of cytotoxic treatments on semen parameters into account.
abstract_ja: 目的：片側精巣がん患者と他の悪性腫瘍患者の治療前精液所見を比較すること。方法：WHO推奨に従い精液分析を、片側精巣がん患者16例（群1）および治療前の他の悪性腫瘍患者21例（群2：非ホジキンリンパ腫7例、ホジキン病6例、白血病3例、骨肉腫2例、直腸がん2例、甲状腺がん1例）に対して実施した。結果：正常精液所見は精巣がん患者では1例もみられなかったが、他の患者では5例に認められた（p=0.047）。精子濃度は群1で群2より有意に低かった（18.7±22.3×10^6/ml対35.6±31.3×10^6/ml、p=0.03）。急速前進運動精子の割合は精巣がん患者で他の悪性腫瘍患者より有意に少なかった（WHO group a：1.1±2.0%対4.7±5.6%、p=0.02）。正常形態精子の割合も群1で少なかった（16.2±6.0%対26.1±18.0%、p=0.03）。結論：精巣がんは特に精液の質に悪影響を及ぼすことが明らかとなった。したがって、細胞毒性治療が精液所見に及ぼす悪影響を考慮し、これらの患者では精液の慎重かつ十分な凍結保存を勧める。
